_claudeconf.note: format milestone (edit tier): file-scoped autofix on the edited file only, non-blocking, silent on success. The payload is parsed by the project's own runtime and biome is invoked by its pinned project-local path rooted at CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR — no jq, no on-demand package runner. Lockfiles are filtered out of the glob. Ownership is recorded in .claudeconf/manifest.json agentHardening.managedHooks[], which is authoritative; this marker is for human readers.

hooks.command: echo 'claudeconf harness, profile 6 (declared): run `node_modules/.bin/lefthook run gate` before any PR. Delegation rule: see `.claudeconf/delegation.md`.'

_claudeconf.note: agent-hardening SessionStart advisory (bounded template; declared, not verified)

permissions._claudeconf: agent-hardening deny module (constitution §4.7 / agent-hardening.md §3): the recorded set is .claudeconf/manifest.json agentHardening.denyPatterns, and a re-run reconciles against THAT — entries beyond it are project-owned and survive. Patterns are `**/`-anchored so nested paths (apps/api/.env) are covered. Defense-in-depth, NOT isolation: deny governs Read/Edit only — Bash is not covered, and spawned interpreters are not covered; .env.example intentionally not denied. runtimeIsolation: not-configured.
